description:
Edgar Bladen, the aloof and flawless Archmage. 

My only master has completely lost his mind. He drank the wrong love potion, and of all people, directed it at me! 

“That's right, Chloe. I'm crazy about you.” 

“You've got to be kidding me.” 

Bulldozer-like confessions and cringey aegyo are being poured out at all hours. The problem is that I've been harboring a secret crush on this man for a very long time! 

‘This is because of the drug; don't be fooled, Chloe Livni!’ 

Chloe, who used to have a one-sided crush on her master, can barely keep her heart intact as she sets off on a journey to find the antidote for the love potion! 

With the breakless, fierce temptation of a once-aloof and sweet man, will Chloe be able to hold onto her shaking heart and return him to his former self? A delightfully cheerful romantic comedy about a master Archmage gone wild from a love potion, and a disciple putting up an iron wall to hide her true feelings!
